title: Portable ad analysis intake conformance rules
description: Apply these rules after JSON Schema validation. A runtime must assert the date and iana-timezone formats and execute every rule before selecting an analysis route.

text_policy.requirement: Every text value must exclude the line-break set everywhere and the boundary set at both ends; an empty value is valid only for fields whose base schema explicitly permits it.

rules.error: run_id must contain a valid calendar date and a sequence from 001 through 999
run_id must match the canonical run folder
brand_slug must match the selected brand manifest
method_version must match the selected brand manifest
every asset_source_ids value must reference sources.source_id
every performance.source_ids value must reference sources.source_id
every performance.ad_mapping value must reference ads.ad_id
every non-null intervention ad_id must reference ads.ad_id
every non-null threshold_basis ad_id must reference ads.ad_id

runtime_context_rules.requirement: The run must be the descriptor-verified outputs/ad-analysis/<RUN_ID> directory inside the selected brand.
Reject duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numbers and every credential-bearing structural field before semantic validation or outward diagnostics.
A file source must remain inside the selected canonical run, use descriptor-relative no-follow access, have one hard link, and retain stable identity and metadata while hashed.
Reject intake JSON over 1048576 bytes or deeper than 32 containers before selecting a mode.
